en: Illustrated maritime postcard showing an ocean liner named VOLENDAM at sea, with two yellow funnels banded in green and white. The ship sails under a Dutch flag at the stern and a U.S. flag on a mast, with another sailing ship in the distant background. Text above mentions the Holland-Amerika Line and the route Rotterdam–New York. Technical data about the ship's tonnage is printed below the image.
